candidates.description: This vector activates for words, suffixes, and character fragments related to nationalities, languages, and European geographical terms.
This vector represents Thai modal verbs and future markers expressing intention, possibility, or necessity.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters, common Thai words, and subwords.
This vector activates on Thai script characters, sub-word tokens, and linguistic sub-components.
This vector is sensitive to the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea) appearing at the end of syllables or words, often attached to various vowel markers and preceding characters.
This feature vector is sensitive to the Thai consonant letter 'ว' (Wo Waen) and its associated character combinations and vowel permutations.
This feature vector activates on common character n-grams found at the end of German and Thai compound words and place names.
This feature vector represents socio-political and economic concepts, cultural terms, and related suffix morphemes across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on terms related to governments, states, and official administrative or political bodies.
This feature vector activates on academic, professional, and cultural domains of human study and practice, along with a significant amount of linguistic noise.
